params.body:
Makes a European provider and Claude Haiku 5.5 measurable on the gold set. No phase default changes, so nothing in production moves with this merge.

## Why

- The verify tier lost its third model family on 2026-08-27, when Together took DeepSeek off serverless. Since then the judge has run on Sonnet, with the lean toward Model A that `DEFAULTS` documents. Llama 3.3 on Together is the only verifier, and Together is a US provider that has withdrawn models twice this summer.
- Mistral is an EU provider. It works under commercial terms with a DPA, and its EU endpoint keeps inference in EU and EFTA data centres. Its API is OpenAI-compatible, so it fits `callOpenAICompat` as it is.
- Classify was 51% of last week's model cost and still runs on Haiku 4.5. Haiku 5.5 costs $0.10/$0.50 per million tokens, a tenth of Haiku 4.5 (platform.claude.com pricing, read 2026-10-09). It has to pass `eval-models` before classify moves.

## What changes

- **New provider.** `mistral` points at `https://api.eu.mistral.ai/v1` with key `MISTRAL_API_KEY`. The EU endpoint bills 1.1x list price and serves no batch.
- **Catalog.**
  - Mistral Small 4 (`mistral-small-2603`), with `reasoning_effort: 'none'` because a verdict must not think out loud.
  - Mistral Large 3 (`mistral-large-2512`).
  - Prices are list x 1.1, from the model pages on docs.mistral.ai.
- **Haiku 5.5** (`claude-haiku-5-5`) is added to the CLI and API catalogs at $0.10/$0.50.
- **Elixir.** `declaredCredentials` now declares any set provider key the same way it declares Together's: the last proof and any refusal, never the secret.
- **Docs.** One paragraph in CLAUDE.md on how to measure the new models. It also notes that only `callModel` phases (the verify tier) follow Settings, while `callLLM` phases always go to the CLI.

## How it was tested

- New `test/mistral-provider.test.mjs` checks four things:
  - the EU endpoint is used;
  - reasoning is off on Small 4;
  - the call is priced and logged with cost above $0;
  - no phase default points at Mistral.
- `declared-keys` covers the Mistral key; `model-catalog` covers Haiku 5.5's price.
- `npm test` on the workbench: 1103 pass, 6 fail. The six are in `report-render` and fail the same way on a clean `origin/main`, because `pdftoppm` (poppler) is not installed on the workbench. They do not touch this change.

## After merge

1. Put a `MISTRAL_API_KEY` in the box's `.env`, from a Mistral organisation account under the Commercial Terms, with a spend cap.
2. Run `node packages/engine/eval-models.mjs classify mistral/mistral-small-2603`, then the same for `mistral/mistral-large-2512` and `claude-cli/claude-haiku-5-5`. Then run `leaderboard classify`.
3. Only if a model clears the bar in the proof-of-concept plan does a phase move, and then in Settings.
params.title: Catalog Mistral (EU endpoint) and Haiku 5.5 so the verify tier can be measured on a European third family
